items.headline: Nvidia has reportedly agreed to buy Hugging Face, the open-source AI model hub, for $12.9 billion according to The Information, though Business Insider reports the talks have not yet produced a signed agreement and could still fall apart; the price would be nearly triple the $4.5 billion valuation Hugging Face carried in its 2023 funding round
items.why: A $12.9 billion price on a company generating roughly $150 million in revenue signals Nvidia paying up to control open-source AI distribution just as OpenAI, Google, Amazon and Anthropic all build custom chips to cut their own dependence on Nvidia hardware.

sources.title: Nvidia closes in on Hugging Face acquisition

items.headline: OpenAI released benchmarks showing its custom Jalapeño inference chip, co-developed with Broadcom, outperforming Nvidia's GB300 on compute-per-watt and response speed when serving DeepSeek R1 and a 1-trillion-parameter Kimi K2.5, with a limited rollout planned this year and a second-generation chip already in development
items.why: OpenAI's chip isn't built for training and keeps the company dependent on Nvidia there, but a credible in-house inference chip directly threatens the fastest-growing, highest-margin part of Nvidia's business.

sources.title: OpenAI says its Jalapeño chip offers spicy performance

items.headline: Bitcoin fell about 2.5% to roughly $77,588, pulling back from a three-month high of $81,455 set Thursday, after US spot Bitcoin ETFs snapped a nine-day streak that had pulled in around $3 billion with a $202 million outflow on Friday, following Fed Chair Kevin Warsh's hawkish first Jackson Hole keynote
items.why: The first ETF outflow day in over a week, arriving right as September rate-hike odds jumped, is an early sign that the institutional buying behind August's rally isn't unconditional.

sources.title: Bitcoin Price Retreats After Warsh's Hawkish Jackson Hole Keynote

items.headline: Ethereum fell 2.7% to about $2,420 and XRP dropped 4.89% to $1.36 alongside Bitcoin's slide, with total crypto long liquidations reaching $350.94 million of $467.81 million in Friday's Jackson Hole-driven risk-off move
items.why: Altcoins falling harder than Bitcoin on the same headline is the standard pattern when a rally built partly on leverage meets a hawkish surprise.

sources.title: Bitcoin Drops 3% Amid Kevin Warsh's Jackson Hole Hawkish Speech

items.headline: Odds of a September Fed rate hike jumped to roughly a coin flip on CME's FedWatch tool, up from about one-in-three before Kevin Warsh spoke, with fed funds futures pricing a nearly 56% chance and Kalshi prediction markets near 48%, after Warsh's first Jackson Hole keynote as Fed chair said recent inflation readings don't show underlying trends have meaningfully improved
items.why: A chair reframing a hike -- not just a hold -- as a live September option resets the reaction function markets had been trading against all summer.

sources.title: Kevin Warsh sends Fed rate hike odds higher

items.headline: Core PCE, the Fed's preferred inflation gauge, held at 3.3% annually in July, in line with estimates but still well above the Fed's 2% target, while headline PCE stayed at 3.7%
items.why: An in-line-but-still-elevated core reading gave Warsh room to sound hawkish at Jackson Hole without any fresh data surprise forcing his hand.

sources.title: July 2026 PCE inflation data: headline above forecast, core in line

items.headline: Oil slid more than 3% on Aug. 25 as Washington signaled it would lean toward economic pressure rather than military escalation against Iran, even as the Strait of Hormuz standoff between the US and Iran remains unresolved
items.why: Markets read the step back from military action as reason to unwind some of the oil risk premium, but an unresolved standoff means that discount can reverse on any fresh escalation.

sources.title: S&P 500 Today – Holds Near 7,683 Ahead of Nvidia's Earnings

items.headline: Gold fell as much as 3.2% intraday to $4,515.30 an ounce Friday, its worst session in six weeks, after Warsh's hawkish Jackson Hole remarks, before paring the loss; bullion remains up roughly 11% for August
items.why: Gold giving back a chunk of its best month since January on one hawkish speech shows how dependent the rally has been on rate-cut expectations rather than pure safe-haven demand.

sources.title: Gold price drops as Warsh warns Fed still has 'work to do' on inflation

items.headline: Silver fell harder than gold, down 4.1% to $67.34 an ounce on Friday, wiping out a week of gains though it remains up sharply for the month
items.why: Silver's larger swing on the same news is a reminder of how much more leveraged it trades to shifts in rate expectations than gold.

sources.title: Gold price drops as Warsh warns Fed still has 'work to do' on inflation

items.headline: Brent crude held near $90 a barrel and WTI steadied as of Aug. 28, with Hormuz shipping flows rising even as Iran's threat to the strait continued
items.why: Oil calming after a volatile 48 hours suggests traders are pricing the Hormuz threat as contained for now, but the underlying standoff has not actually been resolved.

sources.title: Brent Crude Holds Near $90 as Hormuz Flows Rise, WTI Steadies — 28 August 2026

items.headline: The Dow Jones recovered from a session low near 53,320 on Aug. 27 to hold above its 50/200-period moving-average cluster at 53,590-53,610 through Aug. 28, with the 15-minute RSI at 64.78, as Nvidia's earnings beat offset early Jackson Hole caution
items.why: Holding above both moving averages after a roughly 460-point round trip in two sessions shows the Nvidia-driven bid absorbed pre-Warsh nerves without breaking trend.

sources.title: DJ30 Analysis, 28 August 2026: Dow Jones Today Holds Near 53,670 as Nvidia Meets Fed Test

items.headline: The S&P 500 consolidated in a 7,664-7,708 range on Aug. 26, holding above both its 50-period (7,673.98) and 200-period (7,678.17) moving averages with the 14-period RSI at 58.35
items.why: Staying above both averages through a choppy 48 hours into Nvidia earnings and Jackson Hole kept the index's multi-week uptrend structurally intact.

sources.title: S&P 500 Today – Holds Near 7,683 Ahead of Nvidia's Earnings

items.headline: Bitcoin was rejected at resistance near $80,300 after the Warsh keynote and slid to test support at $76,800-$77,000, with the daily RSI at 70 and the Stochastic near 85 signaling stretched, overbought conditions even after the pullback
items.why: Holding the $76,800 support zone on the first real test since the rally began keeps the uptrend alive, but the overbought reading leaves little room for another failed bounce.

sources.title: Bitcoin Price Retreats After Warsh's Hawkish Jackson Hole Keynote

items.why: Nvidia's reported $12.9 billion move to acquire Hugging Face keeps it in the headlines even as OpenAI's new Jalapeño chip poses a credible inference-side challenge.

sources.title: Nvidia closes in on Hugging Face acquisition
